title: B7: Add String.sentenceCased extension
description: Add a new Swift file in CookbookApp/Recipes/ (e.g., StringExtensions.swift) containing a String extension with a sentenceCased computed property. The property uppercases only the first character of the string and leaves the rest verbatim. Must handle empty strings, single characters, and multi-byte first characters (e.g., accented letters) correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Extension lives in its own new file and is accessible to IngredientsView and CookwareView

handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used Character.first / Character.uppercased() + dropFirst() rather than unicodeScalars-based approach to correctly handle decomposed grapheme clusters (e.g. e + combining acute). Character.uppercased() returns String and handles all Unicode edge cases through Swift's built-in grapheme cluster engine.
